newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end at 21.5 pct in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end at 21.5 pct in liquid market.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates eased slightly in continuing abundant money supply and were seen easing further during the week, traders said on Monday.
O/N rates finished at 21.5 percent, compared with Friday's close of 21.5/21.625 percent.
"All signs indicate that the rates would hover between 21 to 21.25 percent for the rest of the week," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
